contexts.text: They do not sit on... raised grassy couches...
(The initial form of the brain) is divided into two beds, as it were.
Each (president) reclined on a couch at the head of his table.
They reclined on couches at the table...
Hence two married partners who... disagree in their affections, lie in bed turned away from each other...
Separation as to bed, bedchamber, and house...
As it were a bedchamber, where love and its own wisdom... share one bed together.
A communion of bed (between married partners).
It is not from a lawful bed...
